html:
Volume of Composite Rectangular Prisms

Split the solid into non-overlapping rectangular prisms. Find each volume using length × width × height, then add the volumes.

Worked example

One part measures 4 × 3 × 2 units, so its volume is 24 cubic units. Another measures 2 × 3 × 1, so its volume is 6. Together they have volume 30 cubic units.

Watch out

Do not count an overlapping region twice. Use cubic units for volume.
